items.title: Mushroom murderer fails to overturn convictions in Australian court challenge
items.description: Erin Patterson argued her trial was unfair due to seven grounds but three appeal judges dismissed them all.

items.title: Record number of purges as Xi emphasises 'party discipline' at China political gathering
items.description: Xi's anti-corruption campaign has become "an effort to consolidate and maintain authority", observers say.

items.title: Syrians struggle with soaring prices as crisis challenges post-Assad recovery
items.description: End of subsidies and rising prices drive discontent, testing support for Ahmed al-Sharaa's government.

items.title: How Kenyans got caught in $130m US ghost student scam
items.description: The alleged scheme used stolen identities to claim US student aid, with Kenyans among those charged.

items.title: 'The city is alive': A brief peace in Kherson, but residents fear what comes next
items.description: A temporary ceasefire has brought rare quiet to Kherson, offering its residents a glimpse of normal life before fighting resumes.

items.title: 'I made the wrong decision,' Hyrox athlete who soiled herself in race tells BBC
items.description: Speaking exclusively to the BBC, Joanna Wietrzyk says her determination to win the Hyrox race in September had clouded her judgement.

items.title: Student-backed election winners demand sweeping resignations in Serbia
items.description: Days after ousting Aleksandar Vučić's party from power, Student List MPs call for top figures to stand down.

items.title: Google value plunges by $500bn as AI search hits ad sales
items.description: Google spooked investors so badly that its stock hit a six-month low, after it revealed its AI search summaries were affecting ad revenue.

items.title: More than 43 million ballots cast so far in midterms early voting surge
items.description: Hispanic voters have helped drive the early voting numbers, which appear to outpace overall turnout for previous elections in some battleground counties.

items.title: New York police will now investigate Cornell sex complaints, governor says
items.description: The change was announced amid backlash over the school's handling of gang rape allegations involving a fraternity on campus.

items.title: Venezuela opposition leader María Machado calls for elections upon return
items.description: Machado, who was in exile for nearly a year, said the transition in Venezuela's government would be "irreversible, organised, pacific".

items.title: Israeli opposition accuses Netanyahu of trying to 'delegitimise' election
items.description: The PM's Likud party has alleged foreign interference and said Arab-led parties "stole" the election after his coalition lost its majority.

items.title: Audio reveals exchanges between Spain train operators and drivers moments before deadly crash
items.description: The leaked tapes appear to show one high-speed train was given clearance to move at normal speed, even though another up ahead had stalled.

items.title: Three dead after two helicopters collide midair near Oregon airport
items.description: The collision involving a Robinson R22 and an Airbus helicopter occurred on Thursday afternoon, with both aircraft crashing in a field adjacent to a highway.

items.title: Flávio Bolsonaro calls himself 'leader of Brazil' after election loss
items.description: The defeated presidential candidate says he will lead the opposition from the US.

items.title: EU chief lays out vision for new Canada partnership at Montreal summit
items.description: Ursula von der Leyen continued to use the term "associate member" for Canada despite some opposition of the bloc's members, including Germany.

items.title: Russian drone attack on Ukrainian train station kills at least 14, officials say
items.description: At least 14 others were wounded in the attack in the central city of Dnipro, including an 11-year-old boy.

items.title: Philippine police obtain warrant to search Thomas Markle's devices
items.description: Images of child sexual abuse allegedly belonging to Meghan's father had reportedly been found in his former home in the Philippines.

items.title: Rock collapse kills two in Turkey's Cappadocia, local media reports
items.description: One of the region's famous rock formations, known as "fairy chimneys", reportedly collapsed outside an open-air museum.

items.title: Details of thousands of US immigration agents leaked in major hack
items.description: A group called the Department of Peace released information on more than 41,000 DHS staff.
